verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that the Dashboard and JSON:API REST APIs give access to customer, account, transaction and other data. That is a developer building block for pulling data, not a documented bulk-export or data-portability feature. Nothing in the pack describes exporting all data in open formats or a migration or offboarding path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
